name: Jio Platforms Limited
summary: Jio Platforms Limited provides mobile and fixed broadband connectivity along with digital products, services, platforms, and applications across entertainment, gaming, cloud computing, cloud storage, and artificial intelligence in India. The company offers 4G and 5G mobile broadband connectivity, international roaming, eSIM, Wi-Fi calling, JioTunes, and VIP mobile numbers; and broadband services, including JioFiber, an optic fibre-based service, and JioAirFiber, a fixed wireless access service.
